messages:
marta: Heads up — on dedicated-us-east we saw ~12% p50 token latency regression after enabling the hybrid kernel router (AWQ <-> GPTQ) last night. Repro on long chat workloads (~1k tokens). :thinking:

samir: Thanks. Any quick flame or perf counters you can paste?

marta: Paste of the hot functions from a short perf sample (10s):
```
awq_kernel             46.2%
gptq_kernel            22.5%
kv_pack_adjust         12.9%
kv_eviction_path       8.6%
tensor_copy            5.5%
other                  4.3%
```
marta: Notable: kv_pack_adjust is higher than baseline and tensor_copy shows extra memcpy.

samir: This smells like slab misalignment + packing fallback loops. When group_size % slab_stride != 0 we do small copies and unpack paths.

kai: Confirmed on a repro run — when avg group_size=48 and slab=64 we hit two extra copy ops per token. Also KV cache eviction rate spikes under high concurrency.

jules: Observed correlation with kv_eviction_rate metric: spike from 0.6/min -> 1.8/min at the same time window. Might be pack-induced footprint growth.

samir: Quick mitigation ideas: prefer GPTQ kernel for group_size < 32 OR when avg_seq_len > 512; otherwise stick with AWQ. Also add a cheap pre-check: if (group_size % slab == 0) prefer AWQ, else prefer GPTQ.

kai: Batcher heuristics I propose: dynamic_min_batch=4, max_latency_ms=18 for this route and enable prefix_kvcache=true for short-payloads to reduce KV churn.

marta: Can we also try a calibration re-run with kv-aware sampling? Current AWQ calib was sampled without regard to packing alignment.

samir: Command I ran locally that reproduces the memcopy hotspot: 
```
RUNTIME_PROF=1 ./serve --model gpt-7b-awq --group-size 48 --slab-size 64 --concurrency 16
```

perf-bot: auto-flame uploaded: https://perf.redwood/fg/3301122334/1 (flamegraph + raw perf) :rocket:

jules: I can pin a canary with reduced concurrency and run a soak for 2 hours to confirm. Suggest toggling the kernel chooser flag for an A/B.

marta: Feature flag snippet to run a canary: 
```
redwoodctl set kernel-chooser --policy hybrid --gptq_threshold 32 --awq_group_size_hint 64 --rollout canary --targets dedicated-us-east-canary
```

kai: For calibration: run `calib-run --sample 10k --strat kv-aware --out /tmp/calib-3301` then feed into build. Also add a post-calib microbench that measures `pack_overhead_ms` per group.

samir: Agreed. I'll add the kernel-chooser guard and a guardrail so we never pick AWQ if pack_overhead > 6ms/sample in profiling.

marta: Action items:
- samir: add chooser guard + pack_overhead metric (owner)
- kai: run calib-run kv-aware and upload results (owner)
- jules: schedule canary soak and monitor kv_eviction & pack_overhead (owner)
- marta: run A/B and baseline benches, post numbers here

marta: Thanks all — reassigning follow-ups in linear. Will post initial AB numbers by EOD. :+1:
